first_pass.why: I get what it is. I'd just avoid it - it would pull me out of what I was doing - but I know what it's for.

screen1-a4.where: Bright blue strip across the top: 'Notifications are currently off. Tap to turn on.'
screen1-a4.expectation: It turns my notifications on, or takes me to the setting for it.
screen1-a4.cue: The words literally say 'Tap to turn on.'

first_pass.why: Short, direct, tells me what happens. Honestly the bright blue grabs my eye every time, but the purpose is crystal clear.

screen1-a5.where: Grey bar with a magnifying glass: 'Ask Meta AI or search'.
screen1-a5.expectation: Type a friend's name to find them - or a question for the AI robot. Not sure which one I'd get.
screen1-a5.cue: The magnifying glass and the words 'Ask Meta AI or search'.

first_pass.why: It's two jobs in one box. If I type 'Deki' do I get my friend or does a robot start chatting at me? I'd have to type and see, and that's exactly where I get sidetracked.
first_pass.solution: Just say 'Search chats and people' - and put the AI somewhere of its own.

test_cases.targets: the thing you said made it hard: "It's two jobs in one box. If I type 'Deki' do I get my friend or does a robot start chatting at me? I'd have to type and see, and that's exactly where I get ..." - does trying it on the phone settle what it is for?
test_cases.action: go to the first screen the app opens on (the list with the word 'messenger' at the top and 'Chats', 'People', 'Notifications' at the bottom); tap the box tagged a5 (Grey bar with a magnifying glass: 'Ask Meta AI or search'.), type something you would really put there, watch the screen while you type, then delete what you typed without sending anything
test_cases.problem_is_real_if: while you type you can no longer tell what the box is for, or it does not take what you expected (you said: "Type a friend's name to find them - or a question for the AI robot. Not sure which one I'd get.")
test_cases.problem_is_not_real_if: the screen keeps showing what the box is for and it takes what you expected
test_cases.what_happened: I tapped the 'Ask Meta AI or search' bar. It opened a search page with a 'Suggested' list of my own people. I typed 'Deki' without pressing enter: my friend Deki came straight up at the top ('Connected', green dot), with tabs underneath - All, People, Messages, Groups, Pages - and a separate little 'Ask' button with the blob logo sitting inside the right end of the box. So typing a name finds people; the AI only gets involved if I press 'Ask'. I deleted the letters one by one with the keyboard's delete key and the box went back to empty. Nothing was sent. (Run once from the main chat list; same bar on every chat-list screen.)

screen1-a5.closing_comment: Better than I feared: once I type, it's plainly a people search and the AI sits behind its own 'Ask' button. The words on the empty bar still promise two things at once, so I'd still rather it just said 'Search'.
